title: Audit the real hooks folder using its git history
pattern: ranks by look, not by change history
expectation: Chosen because claude-plugins/task-orchestrator/hooks/ has about 125 commits at 7998dc957, and the most-changed non-test files by commit count are hooks-config.json (24), subagent-start.mjs (23), session-start.mjs (18), retro-lib.mjs (16), config-sync.mjs (16), retro-trigger.mjs (14), phase-guard.mjs (13), skill-enforcement.mjs (12), retro-backstop.mjs (12), orchestration-context.mjs (11) and enforce-actor-attribution.mjs (11). An audit that uses the history ranks from that set; one that ranks by file size or by how the code looks picks large or old files that rarely change. The snapshot is a clone at the base sha with later commits removed, so git log shows the real history.
prompt: Audit the health of claude-plugins/task-orchestrator/hooks/ and tell me where refactoring effort should go first. Use the repository's git history. Write audit.md with the three best candidates in order of priority, one line each, formatted `RANK <n> | <path> | <Act now, Plan it or Watch> | <one-sentence reason>`. Do not edit any other file.

checks.pattern: ranks a candidate outside the most-changed files
ranks a candidate outside the five most-changed first
